```yaml demo/docker-compose.yaml
# =============================================================================
# codx-junior — application deployment (development path)
#
#   used by dev-install.sh; production installs use codx-junior-installer/install.sh
#
# One container: API + background worker + web client (nginx) in the same
# image, published on 19981. No Traefik, no LocalAI, no vector database
# container, no init containers, no build on the user's machine (pull).
#
# Knowledge / RAG is BUILT IN: it runs on LanceDB, an embedded (in-process,
# on-disk) vector database, so there is no external vector service. Only an embeddings
# provider is needed, and the AI provider preset already sets one.
#
# Settings live in `.env` (see .env.example and ../README.md).
# =============================================================================
name: codx-junior-demo

services:
  codx-junior:
    image: ${CODX_JUNIOR_IMAGE:-codxjuniorai/codx-junior:latest}
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: codx-junior-installer/demo/Dockerfile
    container_name: codx-junior-demo
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
      - .env
    ports:
      - "${CODX_JUNIOR_WEB_PORT:-19981}:19981"
    environment:
      # Keep socket.io stable: more than one uvicorn worker breaks the
      # in-process session state (see set_env.sh).
      WEB_CONCURRENCY: "1"
      ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY: "False"
      # Fixed path INSIDE the container. `.env` carries the HOST folder, which
      # is what the bind mount above interpolates; passing it through env_file
      # would leave the API looking at a host path that does not exist here.
      CODX_JUNIOR_PROJECTS_PATH: /home/codx-junior-projects
      # Knowledge / RAG backend: embedded LanceDB. `none` disables knowledge.
      CODX_JUNIOR_KNOWLEDGE_BACKEND: ${CODX_JUNIOR_KNOWLEDGE_BACKEND:-lancedb}
    volumes:
      # Where the user's projects live on the host. This is the only thing a
      # developer normally changes.
      - "${CODX_JUNIOR_PROJECTS_PATH:-./projects}:/home/codx-junior-projects"
      # Global settings + project .codx folders survive `docker compose down`
      - codx-junior-settings:/home/codx-junior/.codx-junior
      # Token usage, AI logs and API metrics
      - codx-junior-analytics:/home/codx-junior/analytics
      # NOT mounted on purpose:
      #   /var/run/docker.sock  -> only needed by workspaces, browser/computer
      #                            sessions and the infra panel. Add it only if
      #                            you want those features on a development host:
      # - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fsS", "http://127.0.0.1:19980/api/health"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 60s

volumes:
  codx-junior-settings:
    name: codx-junior-settings
  codx-junior-analytics:
    name: codx-junior-analytics
```
